content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a general question. I ordered an analog output module [article_no] but it won't arrive for a few weeks. My goal is to control a 0-10V output from the [product_name] webpage. I've been practicing and want to confirm I'm going in the right direction. I've noticed I can use a slider in [product_name] to write the analog output, but is it possible to use the rainbow gauge for writing as well, or is it just display-only? I'm not sure which SFBs to use in [product_name] but I'm researching each block to understand them. I assume parameter VM mapping will be necessary. Any help or information is greatly appreciated.

The 'Rainbow' component is only meant to display analog values and cannot be used for writing values; there isn't an option to make it writable in its settings. For the slider, its ability to write values depends on how it's configured. You can use a word from the VM memory or an analog marker. To write a value from VM memory using the slider, you need parameter VM mapping to send the slider's value to the parameter of a block (for example, an analog multiplexer).

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for clarification on whether certain graphical components in [product_name] can be used for writing analog values or only for display. There is uncertainty about the features of web components and the process of linking user inputs to analog outputs using parameter mapping. The community clarified that the rainbow gauge is read-only, while the slider can write values if properly mapped.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to use both the slider and rainbow gauge for writing analog output values, and is seeking advice on proper configuration and parameter mapping.
